source.quote: The Global Innovation and Technology Center, located in Leuven, Belgium, accommodates the Product, Packaging, Raw Material, Process and Dispense Development teams and has facilities such as Labs, Experimental Brewery and Sensory Analysis.

notes: All figures are from the FY2025 20-F (as of 31 December 2025), which reports plants and employees only by business segment: 205 beverage plants and 136,805 full-time employees (about 137,000, down from about 144,000 a year earlier). The 20-F defines North America as the United States and Canada and South America as Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Paraguay and Uruguay, so those regions carry country lists; Middle Americas, EMEA and Asia Pacific include "other ... countries" and get null. Global Export and Holding Companies (5,168 employees) is not a geography and is left out. The plant table notes that in December 2025 AB InBev announced the sale of its Newark, New Jersey brewery and the closure of its Fairfield, California and Merrimack, New Hampshire breweries, expected in 2026; they are still counted at year end. No country, U.S.-state or tax-by-country breakdown was found in the 20-F, and no AB InBev tax-by-country report was found. Anheuser-Busch's U.S. "Economic Impact" page (anheuser-busch.com) shows only national figures and blocks automated fetches, so it was not used.
